statement: TCS subsidiary HyperVault and partners committed 700 billion rupees (about $7.4 billion) to build an up-to-1-gigawatt AI data-center campus on 264 acres in Hyderabad.
why: A gigawatt-scale committed build in India adds a large new non-hyperscaler buyer of accelerators, power and cooling, and signals that AI capacity spending is broadening beyond the US majors.

impact.mechanism: Committed capital and secured land convert into future orders for accelerators, electrical equipment and cooling as the phases are built out.

evidence.excerpt: TCS subsidiary HyperVault and its partners will commit '700 billion rupees (~$7.4B)' to build a 1 gigawatt AI data-center campus in Hyderabad, Telangana.

confidence.basis: Secondary outlet reporting a company announcement; a second outlet is referenced only by headline, so corroboration is incomplete.
